transcript.text: Good morning everyone. I understand the locating fixture on Assembly Cell 2 cracked during the last shift, and we have an alternate fixture available in the tooling crib that may be suitable. Before I can authorize any temporary run, we need to work through our standard requirements: documented validation of the alternate fixture, an operator briefing, and defined controls. I'd like to start by hearing from tooling and quality on the condition of the alternate fixture and what validation steps we need to complete. Once we have that information, I can make the authorization decision and record the commitments as part of the temporary change documentation.
